title: Introducing yourself and describing people
grammar: Verb To Be, possessive adjectives, Have got

phases.name: Presentation
phases.content: In this unit you will learn how to introduce yourself and describe other people. You will see how to use the verb To Be (am/is/are), possessive adjectives (my/your/his/her) and the verb Have got to talk about what you have.

phases.name: Discovery
phases.content: Read these sentences and pay attention to the words in bold. My name is Ana. I am 25 years old. I have got two brothers. She is from Spain. Her name is Lucia. Notice how My, Her and His change depending on who is speaking.

phases.name: Guided practice
phases.explanation: We use My as a possessive adjective before a noun.

phases.name: Free practice
phases.prompt: Write 3 sentences introducing yourself: your name, your age and something you have.
